summary: Kinross Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on June 1, 2026, to report the issuance of a press release announcing the publication of its 2025 Sustainability Report. The report details the company's sustainability strategy, performance, and recognition in ratings. No financial terms, transaction details, or special-situation events (such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes) are disclosed. The filing is a routine update of non-material corporate information, akin to a regular sustainability report release. It does not involve any deal terms, board recommendations, or catalysts for risk-arbitrage.
